title: Lily Bit of Tweaks
description: Vanilla-like tweaks and fixes for everyday vanilla use
body:
## What is Lily Bit of Tweaks?
Lily Bit of Tweaks is a vanilla-like Tweaks Resource Pack intended for everyday vanilla gameplay. It makes both barely notisable and drastic changes, but it will always aim to make it an improvement over vanilla for a general audience. 

Lily Bit of Tweaks started of as a small Resource Pack just for me with multiple small tweaks that I would always prefer on. This Resource Pack slowly grew until I thought of publishing it.

## Feedback?
If you find any issues with the pack or have suggestions for new features feel free to join the Discord Server and let me know!
